title: evolvulus alsinoides var. linifolius
intro: Evolvulus alsinoides var. linifolius, commonly known as Blue Daze, is a flowering plant species in the family Convolvulaceae. It is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus alsinoides var. linifolius include anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
